prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a sideswipe while changing lanes. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1186; do not mention it.)
text:
I am writing to advise that this office now represents the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is presently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

Kindly provide a complete statement of the liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, together with declarations pages and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. We also request written confirmation of the claim number assigned to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling it.

Please take immediate steps to preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, dashcam or telematics data, recorded statements, repair estimates, vehicle inspection reports, witness materials, and any electronic records or communications concerning the incident. Routine destruction or alteration of such materials must be suspended until this matter is fully resolved.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
